chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring, killing both Leaf Slimes and reducing Twig Slime (S) to 7 HP, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S) to kill it.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S) first and Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring second; it also clears all three enemies.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It spent All Streams Flow to the Sea instead of preserving it and left Water's Edge unplayed; the reversed ordering was the same apparent clear given only the printed information.
q4_different_intent: No. Because this line clears all three enemies this turn, a different telegraphed intent would not have changed it.
